title: Newgrange curbstone with perplexing symbols

tellings.quote: within New Graange, there is a curb stone outside of New Graange that's inscribed with all of these perplexing symbols.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, describes Newgrange, a very old stone mound tomb in Ireland. He says that a curbstone, one of the large stones set around the outside of the mound, is carved with many puzzling symbols. He raises it as a sign that the ancient builders were recording something we do not yet understand.
